groups.saying_opens: يقوم من بعدي اثنا عشر أميرا

notes: Two sayings. Saying 1 is the Prophet's «يقوم من بعدي اثنا عشر أميرا» (rule 4a).

Saying 2: Jabir asks his father («سألت أبي»), who answers «قال: كلهم من قريش» (rule 5: asker is a link; rule 6: the answerer is the last link). The father is named only by relation. The leading «8 -» report number is stripped.
